status: Official employer-hosted posting available 2026-11-09; reconfirm before applying

headline: From implementation to measurable classroom adoption
thesis: Build a district-and-school customer success model translating school priorities into observable product outcomes, supporting onboarding, stakeholder engagement, renewal readiness and responsible account expansion.
requirements: Own school and district customer experience within assigned territory
Align Instructure platform usage to each district's goals
Partner with Sales and Renewals on existing customer retention and growth
Track CSAT and net revenue retention indicators
Manage escalations and prioritize requests in changing environment
Apply K-12 instructional and stakeholder context to product adoption
phases: Inventory district stakeholders, contractual goals, user segments and adoption barriers
Account health baseline, district success-map and risk register
Design onboarding interventions and teacher administrator enablement
Role-based enablement plan, adoption playbook and metrics dashboard
Evaluate the pilot and align renewal priorities with observed outcomes
K-12 customer QBR, prioritized expansion hypothesis, 90-day delivery plan
